title: Chapter 1198
text:
In Mount Huangjin, a large base was embedded in the belly of the mountain. Battleships and teams of mechanical guards hovered in the sky, and the defense was tight.

This was the main base of the "Apocalypse Foundation", the largest guild alliance of the Limitless Financial Group. Sixty to seventy percent of the mountain had been transformed into mechanical defense facilities. They relied on the main base to constantly clean up the surrounding small strongholds and expand their territory. They had become one of the two major forces in this area.

In the middle of the third night of the battle, the Mount Huangjin stronghold sent out three trump cards to attack the Hex Armed Forces in the Wind Hunting Valley. This was another large guild alliance that occupied the area. The two sides had been competing for the overlord position in the area.

The Hex Armed Forces had detected the enemy attack early on and pulled out their troops. The two sides fought fiercely outside the Wind Hunting Valley.

However, just as the fierce battle was in full swing, a guild alliance called the Reverse Crusade launched a surprise attack on the Mount Huangjin stronghold.

They had planned it long ago and sent troops to ambush nearby a day and a half in advance. They also planted a secret resurrection point. Seeing the opportunity when the main forces of the two sides were fighting fiercely, they attacked the relatively empty base camp of the Apocalypse Foundation, intending to take advantage of the situation.

The Apocalypse Foundation was in a disadvantageous situation of fighting on two fronts. They wanted to withdraw the troops that were attacking the Wind Hunting Valley, but the Hex Armed Forces seemed to have expected the appearance of the Reverse Crusade and entangled the main force of the Apocalypse Foundation. Obviously, the ambush of the Reverse Crusade was related to them. The two sides may have reached some kind of strategic cooperation.

At this moment, the Mount Huangjin stronghold had become a fierce battlefield. A large number of artillery ships and combat robots were fighting in the air. The sky was constantly exploding with fireworks, and the ground was full of players killing each other. Every second, a large number of people turned into light and disappeared.

The trump cards of the Apocalypse Foundation were basically sent out. There were not many elites guarding the stronghold, and most of them were peripheral members. Facing the attack of the elites of the Reverse Crusade, the defense forces of the Mount Huangjin stronghold were defeated, and the battle line was constantly approaching the stronghold.

Unfavorable battle reports were sent back to the main command room of the stronghold, making the leader of the Apocalypse Foundation, "Sisyphus", anxious.

"No wonder the Hex Armed Forces deliberately provoked us this morning. They were trying to lure us into a fight. We fell into their trap! Impulsiveness is indeed the devil! "

Sisyphus was full of regret.

He hurriedly contacted the vice president who led the crusade against the Hex Armed Forces in the chat channel.

"Hurry up and come back to support us. Our home base is about to fall!"

"Boss, we can't retreat. The Hex Armed Forces are too close. If we want to go back, all of us will have to die. This is our main force, and the average death count is already 5.14. If it goes up by one more point, we will be too passive. Furthermore, even if they do return, the warships and weapons they send out will all be seized by the enemy! "

"Look at the situation we're in now. So what if we lose a little? Protecting our home is more important!"

"No, the enemy is obviously prepared. If we all die, they will definitely take advantage of the situation to attack our hometown and join forces with the Reverse Crusade to attack!"

Hearing that, Sisyphus scratched his head in frustration.

He had been caught off guard. Now that it was two against one, the Apocalypse Foundation alone would not be able to hold on. He could only seek help from the other guild alliances that were also on the Limitless Financial Group's front.

"I hope we can hold on until the reinforcements arrive. We're definitely going to suffer heavy losses this time …"

With a heavy heart, he turned his gaze back to the real-time battlefield projection. However, at this moment, he was stunned.

"This … What's going on?"

He hurriedly looked up at the commander and the members of the Military Advisor Group and found that these people had the same shocked expression as if they had seen a ghost.

The surveillance screen showed the front battlefield outside the Golden Mountain stronghold. One of the Reverse Crusade's suicide squads broke through the line of defense and arrived in front of a group of damage dealers.

"Kill them!"

Flames of various colors suddenly swelled. This suicide squad used their skills and was about to focus fire.

However, at this moment, their movements stopped in unison. The light on their bodies suddenly disappeared, and all their skills were interrupted. They froze in place.

Not only this suicide squad, but a large number of Reverse Crusade players also had the same situation. It was as if they had pressed the freeze button at the same time, causing their movements to suddenly stop, causing the troops to instantly disconnect and the lineup to tear apart.

On the interface of these people, the same prompt popped up at the same time.

Sorokin (Possessed) used [Mind Shock] on you!

Determining … Determination passed. You are temporarily unable to control your body.

Your skill has been forcibly interrupted. You have entered the [Stiff] state.

In an instant, the situation took a turn for the worse. Originally, the Reverse Crusade had seen the dawn of victory, but at this moment, they suddenly slid into the abyss.

At this moment, only a 'f * ck' could accurately express the emotions of all the players who had been hit.

You even called out a Beyond Grade A?

Shameless!

Is your Limitless Financial Group's guild unable to afford this?

This short stun instantly turned the situation around. The players of the Apocalypse Foundation did not stop. With a series of explosions, they took away a large number of Reverse Crusade players without any damage and took back the battle line.

The players of the Apocalypse Foundation were also shocked, but it was not entirely because of the sudden stop of the Reverse Crusade. It was more because the players fighting on the frontlines also received notifications on their interfaces.

Sorokin (Possessed) used [Spirit Encouragement] on you!

You have entered the [Spirit Encouragement] state. All attributes increased by 10%.

Sorokin (Possessed) used [Spirit Encouragement] on you!

Your damage increased by 18%. Your defense increased by 12%.

"What's going on?"

"Where did the bonus come from? Did someone use a Character Summon Card? "

"That's not right. Even if a Character Summon Card is used, it won't change the user's name!"

The troops on the frontlines could not understand, nor did they have time to think. They quickly took advantage of the moment when the enemy was hit to kill them all.

Not long after, more than half of the Reverse Crusade troops died. Everyone originally thought that it was a hopeless situation, but they did not expect to deal with the fierce enemy so easily.

Before Sisyphus could come back to his senses, the vice president shouted in the chat channel with a surprised tone, "What's the matter?

"President! We actually defeated the Hex Armed Forces! I don't know why, but their movements suddenly stopped! "

"It can't be?" Sisyphus quivered and quickly asked the commanders at all levels. Only then did he figure out what had just happened, and he was dumbfounded.

What's going on? Sorokin is here? But we didn't call him! Why did he take the initiative to join in the fun?

Could it be that he saw that we were in danger, so he took the initiative to help?

Sisyphus' eyes widened. There was no joy on his face after a successful counterattack, only fear and anger.

If it were any other time, we might be moved, but now …

What does it have to do with you? What the f * ck are you worrying about? You're going to kill us!

…

The next day …

"Look at the clattering of iron hooves ~ Trampling over thousands of miles of rivers and mountains ~? I'm standing at the heart of the storm, holding tightly ~ The sun and moon rotating ~? "

Han Xiao hummed softly as he walked out of the bathroom.

The towel was wrapped around his waist, revealing his strong and slender upper body. Water droplets slid on his firm skin, and the magic circuit on his chest was like a glowing dark blue tattoo, flickering with his breathing.

Pinnacle Beyond Grade As could basically never rest, but Han Technician had always valued the balance between work and rest. He had built seven or eight King mechanical suits in the past few days, and the results were remarkable, so he would not build it today.

Without adjusting his body temperature to evaporate the water, Han Xiao obediently dried his body, lay back on the bed, and habitually opened the forums, intending to have some fun.

However, as soon as he entered the forums, his expression suddenly became strange.

"The Apocalypse Foundation violated the rules and invited a Beyond Grade A assistant? Isn't this one of the guild alliances under the Limitless Financial Group? "

Han Xiao clicked on the post, only to see that the replies had already reached tens of millions, extremely exaggerated.

The content of the post was the condemnation of the Apocalypse Foundation by the Reverse Crusade and Hex Armed Forces. After a day of fermentation, this matter had already set off a storm among the players. Countless players were filled with righteous indignation, accusing the Apocalypse Foundation of breaking the rules.

"This is too much! We were about to win, but who would have thought that the Apocalypse Foundation would be such a sore loser? They actually invited the leader of their own faction and directly used this method to turn the tables. This is simply cheating! "

"There are tons of videos and screenshots. Let's see how you explain this!"

"That's right! Yesterday, someone actually tried to clear the ground and said that this was the effect of the Character Summon Card. Bullsh * t! Since when can a Character Summon Card change the user's name? "

"This kind of unfair behavior must be severely punished. I propose to cancel the qualification of the Apocalypse Foundation to participate in the battle. Since you can't afford to play, then don't play!"

The forums were basically filled with angry condemnation. Han Xiao glanced around and saw that the Apocalypse Foundation had also posted a clarification post.

"I'm the president of the Apocalypse Foundation. It's not what you think. We did not ask for Sorokin's help. He did it himself, and it has nothing to do with us. Everyone, please think about it. We knew the consequences of breaking the rules, so how could we deliberately violate them?"

Sisyphus explained a lot in the post, but in the face of the angry players, it was not convincing at all. Instead, it was mocked and ridiculed.

"Hehe, keep making things up."

"So, when you ask for a Beyond Grade A's help, all you have to do is say that you were not the one who asked for it, and you can wash away your responsibility.

"What, only you have a Beyond Grade A? Who are you looking down on? "

"You want to play this game, right? Men, quickly go and invite the Old Ancestor Black Star! "

Most people did not believe this statement, but the players on the Limitless Financial Group's side believed it by about sixty to seventy percent. They were immediately worried.

"No way, is that dog Sorokin so troublesome? This is a trap! "

"He's like a ticking time bomb! If it happens to us, won't we be disqualified too? "

"Let me ask, is it too late to change factions now?"

"Level 180 Psychic, all core skills above level 7, please accept me!"

Sorokin's actions had completely frightened the players of the Limitless Financial Group. Some of them even wanted to change factions in order to continue participating in the national war, not daring to stay in this organization that could explode at any time.

After reading the post, Han Xiao finally understood what was going on.

"This guild shouldn't be lying. All of this was most likely done by Sorokin on his own accord. As for his goal … hmm, I remember that he's always been passionate about recruiting players. Could it be that he concluded the pattern from my actions and wants to increase the attractiveness of his faction?"

After understanding the cause and effect, Han Xiao tried to guess Sorokin's logic and almost laughed out loud.

"So that's how it is … This guy thought that his actions were very secretive and only used some support type mental abilities to make others think that it was the Limitless Financial Group's players who went berserk or used some special mental weapon. Under normal circumstances, it would not be so easy to link it to him … but the combat information has already sold you out, stinky little brother."

Han Xiao secretly smiled.

Little Sorrowless, oh Little Sorrowless, you've shot yourself in the foot this time. You've used the wrong method. Originally, you wanted to farm reputation, but now it has the opposite effect. Instead, you've ruined your reputation among the players.

The worst thing was that this guy could not see the forums, so he was still in the dark and did not know that he was being scolded by the players.

"This is the advantage of having poor information …"

Han Xiaoxin thought.

Sorokin's actions would definitely lose some of the Limitless Financial Group's players. Just nice, when these players were feeling empty and lonely, he could use his thick chest to warm them up and recruit them into the army. No matter how many he recruited, it would be a profit.

"Sorokin, I didn't mean to snatch your leeks. This time, you're the one who delivered them to me …"

Han Xiao chuckled.

This feeling of sitting at home and not doing anything, just watching the enemy play themselves to death … was really a little comfortable.

…

Ever since he intervened yesterday, Sorokin had been paying attention to the subsequent developments. However, he did not see the situation he expected, and he could not help but feel puzzled.

Logically speaking, the Apocalypse Foundation turning the tables with his help should have more or less caused the other Immortals to be amazed by the strength of the Limitless Financial Group's camp, but why did these people not react?

It was not until the next day that he saw the Apocalypse Foundation's reaction. It was not the pursuit of victory that he expected but the abandonment of the base, leaving the planet in a battleship, and withdrawing from the battlefield.

"Strange, what kind of reaction is this?"

In the office, Sorokin watched the live broadcast of the frontline news media, feeling a little incredulous.

Just as he was feeling puzzled, Sorokin suddenly received a pop-up report from his artificial intelligence. With just a glance, his heart skipped a beat.

The report was full of resignation notices from the Immortals, and the number was still increasing rapidly.

"What's going on? Why are they withdrawing from the Limitless Financial Group? "

Sorokin was stunned. Suddenly thinking of something, he quickly turned to look at the interface of the news broadcast.

On the screen, batches of Immortals belonging to the Limitless Financial Group flew out of the stronghold and scattered in all directions. Some went to visit other neutral factions, but more went directly to the three mainstream factions, such as the Black Star Army Faction. The rules did not restrict the players from changing factions on the spot, and the major guild alliances guaranteed the freedom of choice for the players. As long as there were no external factors, the rules allowed for the players to fight today and join tomorrow.

The nature of the Limitless Financial Group was a galactic financial group. To the players, there was not much faction cohesion. Those who joined were all for the high benefits, so there was nothing to be reluctant about changing factions. And now, the first World Server War was destined to be recorded in the Galaxy Chronicles. If they missed this opportunity, they would not have another chance. In order to not be inexplicably disqualified, some of the Limitless Financial Group players did not hesitate to betray the faction on the spot.

"This …"

Seeing this scene, Sorokin was a little dumbfounded.

The method I used, the principle is clearly the same as Black Star's, so why did it have the opposite effect?

No, this is not how the script is written!
